review_notes: Reviewed all declarations and proofs in lines 1–362, including the recursive fold API and Clifford-algebra reverse lemmas. One proof has a clear simplification using the same named identities; I did not check whether the proposed replacement compiles.

findings.problem: The proof manually rewrites the definition of `contractRight` twice before applying the left-contraction result. A `simp only` block can express these same steps by their named identities, without the extra definition-expansion bookkeeping.
findings.proposed_change: Replace the proof with `by simp only [contractRight_eq, reverse_reverse, contractLeft_contractLeft, map_zero]`.
findings.benefit: This keeps the mathematical argument visible—convert right contraction to left contraction, use its square-zero theorem, and map zero—while avoiding a manually ordered rewrite sequence.
